description: Check AI host security: MCP configurations, hooks, base URL hijacking, environment variable exposure. NOT the same as audit_config which checks application config files (next.config, .env, headers). Use scope=project (default) for project-only, scope=host to include shell profiles and global AI configs. Example: guardvibe_doctor({scope: 'project'})

scope.description: Scan scope: project (default, .claude.json + .cursor/ + .vscode/ + .env), host (+ shell profiles + global MCP configs), full (+ home dir configs)
